// This file is a negative-control fixture for
// internal/audit/module_pins_test.go — it deliberately contains a
// below-floor golang.org/x/net declaration and must NEVER be brought up
// to the recorded floor by a well-meaning future dependency sweep: doing
// so would silently disarm the non-vacuity proof this fixture provides
// for TestNoModuleDeclaresAKnownVulnerablePin. It is kept under testdata
// (the Go tool never compiles anything there, and this package's own
// repo-wide walk skips testdata directories too via shouldSkipDir) and
// named with a .go.mod.txt suffix, mirroring
// testdata/foreign_host_violation.go.txt's role for the egress scanner,
// so no editor or Go tool ever treats it as a real module manifest.
module github.com/example/vulnerable-fixture

go 1.25.0

require (
	github.com/some/legitimate-dep v1.2.3
	golang.org/x/text v0.38.0 // indirect
)

require golang.org/x/net v0.26.0 // indirect
